summary: Frontend-only test of ScrollToTop fix on Léomentia Event site. Navigated between all top nav tabs after scrolling ~2000px each time; verified window.scrollY resets to near 0 after each route change. Also verified blog article navigation. Fix works as expected.

issues: After navigating to '/' from another page (e.g. /contact) with prior scroll, window.scrollY lands at ~82 instead of 0 (visually still near top / hero visible). Likely caused by post-mount layout shift or hero animation in HomePage; ScrollToTop still fires correctly. Other pages measured 0-9px which is acceptable.

action_items: Optional: investigate small residual scroll (~82px) on HomePage after navigation — likely a hero component mounting effect; consider a second scrollTo(0) after images/hero mount or use useLayoutEffect in ScrollToTop.
critical_code_review_comments: ScrollToTop implementation is minimal and correct (useLocation pathname dep). Consider useLayoutEffect to eliminate the brief flash of prior scroll position before repaint.
Component correctly returns null and is placed inside <BrowserRouter> before <Navigation/> in App.js.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the ScrollToTop fix (all 6 tabs + blog article scroll to top after route change)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested tabs testids: nav-link-accueil, nav-link-services, nav-link-galerie, nav-link-témoignages (note accent in testid: label.toLowerCase()), nav-link-blog, nav-link-contact. Blog article /blog/organiser-mariage-sans-stress reached scrollY=0 after nav from scrolled blog list. Viewport 1920x800. No blocking console errors observed.
rca of the issue: N/A - fix verified working. Root cause of original bug was React Router not restoring scroll on client-side nav; fixed by ScrollToTop component calling window.scrollTo({top:0}) in useEffect on pathname change.
